hushgram.title: v0.0.22
hushgram.body:
HushGram still patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so you patch the same way as last time. Most of this release came from you: 57 of the changes below started with one of your reports or requests. You can blur a chat behind a message you're holding, record calls, lock a collection right from Saved, keep the tab bar on reel links and hide comments that use your blocked words. There are 44 fixes too.

Fixes

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, a story you open no longer covers the whole screen for a moment before jumping up above the gesture bar. Reported in #618.

- Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.

- The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.

- The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.

- `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.

- `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.

- Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.

- `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.

- Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.

- With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.

- Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.

- The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.

- An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.

- The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.

- `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.

- Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.

- `Fill the screen` goes grey with a line saying why while `Show the whole reel` is on, since that switch wins and reels kept their side bars. Reported in #755.

- `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.

- The seek bar on reels no longer sits under the floating tab bar after you come back from picture in picture. Reported in #450.

- With the tab bar hiding on Reels, dragging a reel's seek bar no longer leaves it sitting on top of the caption once you let go. Reported in #450.

- Logging in with Facebook no longer stops on Facebook's "link may be broken" page and a spinner that never ends. The Facebook app turns away a patched Instagram, so the login goes through your browser now. Reported in #760.

- Reels that run behind the glass tab bar sit where they should again instead of up against the top of the screen with a black band under them. Reported in #763.

- Unfolding a foldable with `Glass tab bar` on keeps every tab in Instagram's side rail now, lined up. Search and your profile used to go missing from it and the rest sat out of line. Reported in #764.

- `Thicker story progress bar` thickens the bar again with a seek bar shape picked. 0.0.21 left a shaped bar as thin as before. Now its line grows like the standard bar's, and the waves keep their size. Reported in #775.

- With `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed` on, tapping a feed video no longer stops it on its cover or leaves it under a play button. Instagram set the video up for Reels before HushGram caught the tap. Reported in #706.

- `Sent follow requests` now catches the Requested button at the top of a profile. Since 456 Instagram sets that button another way, so a request you sent from someone's profile never made it onto the list. Reported in #690.

- `Text size` stays put when you turn your phone or change one of its settings. Captions in the feed went back to your phone's own size after that, until Instagram was closed and opened again. Reported in #782.

- Signing in no longer closes Instagram on a phone without Google Play services, like a de-Googled ROM or one running microG. `Run without Play services` is on by default and has no switch. Reported in #767 and #748.

- On a narrow phone, HushGram's buttons at the top of a chat fold into one More button that holds all of them, so the chat's name shows and the last call button isn't cut off. Reported in #802.

- Bigger text from Text size no longer makes a chat's message box taller. The space around the text shrinks first, and only then does the box's text come down a little, still bigger than the phone's size. Reported in #806.

- `See who a story mentions` brings its list back after you watch the story of a profile you opened from it. Watching that story still closed the list, so going back to the first story left it shut. Reported in #403.

- The Lens button on reels and stories sees the video now instead of a black box. Instagram plays some videos on a layer of its own, which HushGram reads now for Lens and the glass tab bar. Reported in #801 and #583.

- Tap download on more than three things at once and the extra ones wait their turn instead of failing with Download failed. The toasts say whose media it is now, like "Saving from @name...". Asked for in #792.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, the little bars that pop up at the bottom (Link copied, Saved and the like) are black now too. They stayed dark gray. Asked for in #816.

- With `See-through top bar` and the glass tab bar both on, the stories row on Home gets the header's glass shine too, so it no longer sits there as a black band between the glass and the posts. Asked for in #800.

- `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` keeps the suggested people off both Follow requests screens now, the old one and the newer page Notifications opens, even when Instagram sends them anyway. Reported in #814.

- `Find the reel you came from` works for reels in your feed too. Tap the name on a reel in Home, open their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel. Before, only the Reels viewer did this. Reported in #795.

- With the wave `Seek bar shape`, the story you're watching no longer shows Instagram's straight bar running under the wave. The straight part now starts where the wave ends. Reported in #796.

- `Ambient light` now glows around photo and carousel reels and reels Instagram plays on its own video layer, and fills the thin black bars above and below a reel. `Rounded corners on Reels` rounds photo reels too. Reported in #796.

- With `Keep 2x after you let go`, the name over a feed video comes back when you let go, and the time readout goes away. Before, they stayed the way they look while you hold. Reported in #552.

- With `Classic colors` or `Backgrounds in the accent color` on, an open chat takes your page color behind the messages and in its header instead of staying black. Chats with a theme of their own keep it. Reported in #528.

- The Messages list keeps your page color when Instagram opens straight into it from a notification. Its rows stayed black until a restart. Reported in #528.

- With `Glass in chats` on, messages no longer jump up and down as a chat opens or the message bar changes height, and the newest one no longer ends up hidden behind the bar. Reported in #528.

Other changes

- `Blur the chat behind a held message` is new under Messages. Press and hold a message and the rest of the chat blurs behind it, so the message and its reactions stand out. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #684.

- `Glass buttons in chats` is new under `Glass in chats`. Turn it off and the buttons at the top of a chat lose their round glass, leaving a plain blur behind them like Instagram's own. Asked for in #684.

- `Even on silent` is new under `Start feed videos with sound`. With your phone on silent or vibrate, Home's videos still start with their sound, as long as the media volume is up. Starts off. Asked for in #762.

- `Record calls` is new under Messages. A Record button saves both sides of a call to your Recordings folder (Music on Android 11 or older) and stops when the call ends. Some places require everyone's consent. Starts off. Asked for in #732.

- `Chat bubbles` is new under Notifications. A chat's notification gets Android's bubble button, so the chat can float over other apps. Hidden and locked chats never get one. Needs Android 11 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #747.

- Press and hold a collection in Saved to lock it or take its lock off, with no trip to settings. Taking a lock off always asks first, the same way your other locks unlock, even with the collection open. Asked for in #678.

- Posts and reels saved into a locked collection now stay out of Saved's All, Posts, Reels and search while it's locked, and its tile hides its cover. They come back after an unlock once Saved refreshes. Asked for in #678.

- `Center names in chats` is new under Messages. The name at the top of a chat sits in the middle, as close as the call buttons allow. Starts off. `Ask before a call` moved to Manager's Interaction group. Asked for in #779.

- `Pinch for clear mode` is new under Reels. Pinching a reel toggles clear mode. `Hide the exit button in clear mode` hides its round button. `Pinch to zoom` wins when on. Both start off. Requested in #744.

- `Let the screen sleep when a reel stops` is new under Reels. With this on, a paused reel lets your phone's screen timeout run. Starts off. `Control the reel above comments` moved to Manager's Comments group. Asked for in #777.

- `Expand captions on reels` is new under Reels and comes with `Expand captions`. Reels show their whole caption. It's separate from the feed one, since a long caption covers more of the video. Starts off. Asked for in #752.

- `Hide Threads posts` is new under Reels, right after `Hide stories in Reels`. It takes out the cards Instagram slips between reels to get you onto Threads. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Asked for in #765.

- `Hide Not interested and Interested` is new under Reels and takes those two buttons off a reel. `Hide 'Are you interested?' bubbles` now covers Home only. If you had it on, the Reels one starts on too. Asked for in #769.

- `Stop swipe to Messages` is new under Feed, after `Stop swipe to create`. On the classic tab bar, a swipe left on Home no longer slides Messages in. The Messages button still works. Starts off. Asked for in #770.

- `Expand captions` is new under Feed. Feed posts show their whole caption. `Caption lines before more` sets a number of lines instead, from one to ten. Stories keep short captions. Starts off. Requested in #771.

- `Hide the line under names` is new under Feed. It clears the song, place and labels under a post's name. `Hide the line under names on reels` covers Reels. Sponsored labels stay. Both start off. Requested in #771.

- `Keep the place` goes with `Hide the line under names`. A post's place stays on that line by itself, so it sits still instead of taking turns with the song. Asked for in #771.

- `Only after a long hold` goes under `Keep 2x after you let go`. A quick hold to peek at 2x goes back to normal speed when you let go, and a hold of about 3 seconds keeps 2x. Asked for in #552.

- `Keep the name while you hold` goes under `Hold for 2x on feed videos`. The name over a feed video stays while you hold it at 2x, and Instagram's 2x and time labels stay off. Asked for in #552.

- `Hide Followers and Following on profiles` is new under Profiles. `Hide follower counts` takes the numbers off and leaves the words. `Hide Followers and Following` takes both buttons away and closes the gap. Both start off. Requested in #771.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you react`. Reacting to something someone sent lets them see you read up to it, and anything newer stays unseen. Starts off. Requested in #772.

- The viewing history page has a grid button next to Clear. It shows what you watched as big covers, three across. Tap it again for the list. The page remembers your pick. Requested in #773.

- `Auto scroll in the reel menu` under Reels puts Turn on auto scroll or Turn off auto scroll in a reel's three-dot menu. It works on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll too. Requested in #768.

- `Hide notifications by type` under Notifications lists the kinds of notifications Instagram has sent you, each with a line from one, and takes the ones you tick off the page. Requested in #756.

- Saving a reel gets its picture and sound at the same time now, instead of one after the other, so saves finish sooner. Asked about in #493.

- A feed post's three-dot menu can now show Block and Playback speed. Turn on `Block in a post's menu` and `Speed in a post's menu` under Downloads. Requested in #743.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` under Feed has five more to untick. A reel's menu can drop Remix and sequence, Use as reference, Use template and Get Edits, and `Loop this video` can come off reel and feed video menus. Asked for in #707.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` has more to untick: Save, the Download rows, Details, About this account, Block, Hide posts from this account, Loop this story and Add to Stories priority, story menus included. Asked for in #707.

- Press and hold the Download button on a story to pick `Download` or `Save all`, which saves every story in the set you're watching. It comes with `Download button on stories`. Requested in #745.

- Under `Default playback quality` there's a new `Drop quality to keep playing` switch. It's on to start, so a slow connection drops a rung instead of stalling. Turn it off to keep the quality you picked. Requested in #761.

- Two new switches under Feed, next to `Hide the Like button`. `Hide counts on posts` takes the like, comment, share and repost numbers off feed posts and keeps the buttons. `Hide Liked by` takes the "Liked by" line off them. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the tag icon on posts` sits right under `Hide the audio icon on posts` in Feed. It takes the little person icon off posts with people tagged in them, and product tags keep theirs. Also from #762.

- `Hide the empty profile prompt` is new in Profiles, under `Hide the Create button`. While your profile has no posts, it takes the big "first post" prompt off your grid. Other people's empty profiles don't change. Asked for in #762.

- Two new switches follow `Hide suggested accounts in Messages`. `Hide the New message button` takes the pencil off your messages. `Hide suggestions in New message` drops Suggested people from the New message and new group screens, and search still works. Asked for in #762.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile now opens the menu's Saved page, starting on All with a back arrow, instead of the grid of collections. Accounts Instagram hasn't given that page yet still get the grid. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the New collection button` sits under `Fast scroll in Saved` in Profiles. It takes the + off the top of Saved, on both Saved screens, and your collections stay where they are. No restart needed. Also from #762.

- `Hide the Reels tab in Saved` and `Hide Saved on the Search tab` are new under `Hide the New collection button`. Saved reels still show under All, and the Search tab change needs a restart. Asked for in #810.

- Two more switches under Comments. `Hide likes on comments` takes the heart and like count off every comment. `Hide the comment box` takes away the box at the bottom, so the comments get that space. Asked for in #762.

- Tap to play's `Where videos wait` can treat Explore on its own now, with four new picks, `Everywhere but Explore`, `Only in Explore`, `Reels and Explore` and `Everywhere but Reels and Explore`. Reels opened from Explore count as Reels. Asked for in #762.

- The video under the HushGram settings pauses while they're open, so it stops playing and loading where you can't see it. Closing the settings plays it again, and a video you'd tapped with Tap to play on stays tapped. Asked for in #762.

- `Light settings page` sits under `Black settings page` in Settings entry. It turns the HushGram settings and the pages they open white, with dark text and status bar icons. The rest of Instagram keeps its own look. Asked for in #762.

- A song's page, the one you reach by tapping a reel's song, has a Download icon beside Save now. It saves the whole song as audio, like `Download full song` in a reel's menu, and follows that switch. Asked for in #741.

- `Find the reel you came from` labels the reel it finds with You just watched, over a dimmed tile with a colored edge, for a few seconds. The old white outline was easy to miss. Asked for in #781.

- `Hide reels with few views` adds limits for maximum views, likes and comments per 1,000 views, length and age, plus `Newest first` and `Also on Home`. 0 means off. Reels from accounts you follow still play. Asked for in #780.

- A chat's clock button menu has `Select messages` now, under Export chat. Tick loaded messages, then copy, share or save them to a text file in Downloads. It comes with `Export a chat as text`. Asked for in #778.

- In Manager's Expert mode the six comment patches have a Comments group of their own now, like the Comments page in HushGram settings, and `HushGram launch screen` moved to Settings. Interaction and Interface were getting too long to scan.

- `Keep the tab bar on reel links` is new under Interaction, with its switch in Reels settings. A reel link from another app, like WhatsApp, plays on your current tab with the tab bar under it. Starts off. Asked for in #385.

- `Blocked words` under `Hide reels by caption words` takes an @name too, like `@cnn`. That account's reels leave the Reels tab, and with `Also on Home` on its posts leave Home as well. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in comments` is new under `Hide reels by caption words`. It hides comments that hold a word from your list, and comments by an account the list names with @. Replies to a hidden comment go with it. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in search`, new under `Hide reels by caption words`, takes a row out of the Explore grid and search results when a post in it matches your list, by its words or its account. Asked for in #807.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` works in chats where you have a Blend with the person too. Swiping up goes through the reels shared in the chat first, and the Blend's reels come after them. Asked for in #804.

- The `Blocked words` row under `Hide reels by caption words` now says how much your list has hidden, in the last 24 hours and in all, counting reels, Home posts and comments. Asked for in #807.

- `Instagram settings page` is new under `Settings entry`. HushGram's settings look like Instagram's own, with plain rows, gray section names and its round switch, in dark or light to match. It wins over the Black and Light looks. Asked for in #797.

- `Don't open reels from chats` is new under Messages. A reel someone shares in a chat stays closed when you tap it, and a short note says reels from chats are off. Photos, videos and shared posts still open. Asked for in #810.

- `Reels on Home below the name` is new under Feed. Reels on Home show like other posts, with the name and three-dot menu above the video instead of on it. Live videos and other reels keep Instagram's layout. Asked for in #788.

- `Time on the seek bar` is new under `Seek bar on stories`. It shows the time played and the story's length, like 0:03 / 0:15, and a tap (or `Show the time left`) counts down instead. Asked for in #784.

- `Copy text in the story menu` is new under Stories. Copy text in a story's three-dot menu copies the words Instagram read in the picture, or opens Google Lens when it found none. Starts off. Asked for in #789.

- `Full-size Reels icon` is new under Tab bar. Instagram's Reels icon is narrower than the others, so it looks small. This draws it a bit bigger to match, on top of your Tab icon size. Starts off. Asked for in #793.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

HushGram still patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so you patch the same way as last time. Most of this release came from you: 57 of the changes below started with one of your reports or requests. You can blur a chat behind a message you're holding, record calls, lock a collection right from Saved, keep the tab bar on reel links and hide comments that use your blocked words. There are 44 fixes too.

Fixes

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, a story you open no longer covers the whole screen for a moment before jumping up above the gesture bar. Reported in #618.

- Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.

- The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.

- The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.

- `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.

- `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.

- Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.

- `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.

- Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.

- With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.

- Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.

- The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.

- An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.

- The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.

- `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.

- Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.

- `Fill the screen` goes grey with a line saying why while `Show the whole reel` is on, since that switch wins and reels kept their side bars. Reported in #755.

- `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.

- The seek bar on reels no longer sits under the floating tab bar after you come back from picture in picture. Reported in #450.

- With the tab bar hiding on Reels, dragging a reel's seek bar no longer leaves it sitting on top of the caption once you let go. Reported in #450.

- Logging in with Facebook no longer stops on Facebook's "link may be broken" page and a spinner that never ends. The Facebook app turns away a patched Instagram, so the login goes through your browser now. Reported in #760.

- Reels that run behind the glass tab bar sit where they should again instead of up against the top of the screen with a black band under them. Reported in #763.

- Unfolding a foldable with `Glass tab bar` on keeps every tab in Instagram's side rail now, lined up. Search and your profile used to go missing from it and the rest sat out of line. Reported in #764.

- `Thicker story progress bar` thickens the bar again with a seek bar shape picked. 0.0.21 left a shaped bar as thin as before. Now its line grows like the standard bar's, and the waves keep their size. Reported in #775.

- With `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed` on, tapping a feed video no longer stops it on its cover or leaves it under a play button. Instagram set the video up for Reels before HushGram caught the tap. Reported in #706.

- `Sent follow requests` now catches the Requested button at the top of a profile. Since 456 Instagram sets that button another way, so a request you sent from someone's profile never made it onto the list. Reported in #690.

- `Text size` stays put when you turn your phone or change one of its settings. Captions in the feed went back to your phone's own size after that, until Instagram was closed and opened again. Reported in #782.

- Signing in no longer closes Instagram on a phone without Google Play services, like a de-Googled ROM or one running microG. `Run without Play services` is on by default and has no switch. Reported in #767 and #748.

- On a narrow phone, HushGram's buttons at the top of a chat fold into one More button that holds all of them, so the chat's name shows and the last call button isn't cut off. Reported in #802.

- Bigger text from Text size no longer makes a chat's message box taller. The space around the text shrinks first, and only then does the box's text come down a little, still bigger than the phone's size. Reported in #806.

- `See who a story mentions` brings its list back after you watch the story of a profile you opened from it. Watching that story still closed the list, so going back to the first story left it shut. Reported in #403.

- The Lens button on reels and stories sees the video now instead of a black box. Instagram plays some videos on a layer of its own, which HushGram reads now for Lens and the glass tab bar. Reported in #801 and #583.

- Tap download on more than three things at once and the extra ones wait their turn instead of failing with Download failed. The toasts say whose media it is now, like "Saving from @name...". Asked for in #792.

- The viewing history page has a grid button next to Clear. It shows what you watched as big covers, three across. Tap it again for the list. The page remembers your pick. Requested in #773.

- `Auto scroll in the reel menu` under Reels puts Turn on auto scroll or Turn off auto scroll in a reel's three-dot menu. It works on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll too. Requested in #768.

- `Hide notifications by type` under Notifications lists the kinds of notifications Instagram has sent you, each with a line from one, and takes the ones you tick off the page. Requested in #756.

- Saving a reel gets its picture and sound at the same time now, instead of one after the other, so saves finish sooner. Asked about in #493.

- A feed post's three-dot menu can now show Block and Playback speed. Turn on `Block in a post's menu` and `Speed in a post's menu` under Downloads. Requested in #743.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` under Feed has five more to untick. A reel's menu can drop Remix and sequence, Use as reference, Use template and Get Edits, and `Loop this video` can come off reel and feed video menus. Asked for in #707.

- `Items in the three-dot menus` has more to untick: Save, the Download rows, Details, About this account, Block, Hide posts from this account, Loop this story and Add to Stories priority, story menus included. Asked for in #707.

- Press and hold the Download button on a story to pick `Download` or `Save all`, which saves every story in the set you're watching. It comes with `Download button on stories`. Requested in #745.

- Under `Default playback quality` there's a new `Drop quality to keep playing` switch. It's on to start, so a slow connection drops a rung instead of stalling. Turn it off to keep the quality you picked. Requested in #761.

- Two new switches under Feed, next to `Hide the Like button`. `Hide counts on posts` takes the like, comment, share and repost numbers off feed posts and keeps the buttons. `Hide Liked by` takes the "Liked by" line off them. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the tag icon on posts` sits right under `Hide the audio icon on posts` in Feed. It takes the little person icon off posts with people tagged in them, and product tags keep theirs. Also from #762.

- `Hide the empty profile prompt` is new in Profiles, under `Hide the Create button`. While your profile has no posts, it takes the big "first post" prompt off your grid. Other people's empty profiles don't change. Asked for in #762.

- Two new switches follow `Hide suggested accounts in Messages`. `Hide the New message button` takes the pencil off your messages. `Hide suggestions in New message` drops Suggested people from the New message and new group screens, and search still works. Asked for in #762.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile now opens the menu's Saved page, starting on All with a back arrow, instead of the grid of collections. Accounts Instagram hasn't given that page yet still get the grid. Asked for in #762.

- `Hide the New collection button` sits under `Fast scroll in Saved` in Profiles. It takes the + off the top of Saved, on both Saved screens, and your collections stay where they are. No restart needed. Also from #762.

- `Hide the Reels tab in Saved` and `Hide Saved on the Search tab` are new under `Hide the New collection button`. Saved reels still show under All, and the Search tab change needs a restart. Asked for in #810.

- Two more switches under Comments. `Hide likes on comments` takes the heart and like count off every comment. `Hide the comment box` takes away the box at the bottom, so the comments get that space. Asked for in #762.

- Tap to play's `Where videos wait` can treat Explore on its own now, with four new picks, `Everywhere but Explore`, `Only in Explore`, `Reels and Explore` and `Everywhere but Reels and Explore`. Reels opened from Explore count as Reels. Asked for in #762.

- The video under the HushGram settings pauses while they're open, so it stops playing and loading where you can't see it. Closing the settings plays it again, and a video you'd tapped with Tap to play on stays tapped. Asked for in #762.

- `Light settings page` sits under `Black settings page` in Settings entry. It turns the HushGram settings and the pages they open white, with dark text and status bar icons. The rest of Instagram keeps its own look. Asked for in #762.

- A song's page, the one you reach by tapping a reel's song, has a Download icon beside Save now. It saves the whole song as audio, like `Download full song` in a reel's menu, and follows that switch. Asked for in #741.

- `Find the reel you came from` labels the reel it finds with You just watched, over a dimmed tile with a colored edge, for a few seconds. The old white outline was easy to miss. Asked for in #781.

- `Hide reels with few views` adds limits for maximum views, likes and comments per 1,000 views, length and age, plus `Newest first` and `Also on Home`. 0 means off. Reels from accounts you follow still play. Asked for in #780.

- A chat's clock button menu has `Select messages` now, under Export chat. Tick loaded messages, then copy, share or save them to a text file in Downloads. It comes with `Export a chat as text`. Asked for in #778.

- In Manager's Expert mode the six comment patches have a Comments group of their own now, like the Comments page in HushGram settings, and `HushGram launch screen` moved to Settings. Interaction and Interface were getting too long to scan.

- `Keep the tab bar on reel links` is new under Interaction, with its switch in Reels settings. A reel link from another app, like WhatsApp, plays on your current tab with the tab bar under it. Starts off. Asked for in #385.

- `Blocked words` under `Hide reels by caption words` takes an @name too, like `@cnn`. That account's reels leave the Reels tab, and with `Also on Home` on its posts leave Home as well. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in comments` is new under `Hide reels by caption words`. It hides comments that hold a word from your list, and comments by an account the list names with @. Replies to a hidden comment go with it. Asked for in #807.

- `Also in search`, new under `Hide reels by caption words`, takes a row out of the Explore grid and search results when a post in it matches your list, by its words or its account. Asked for in #807.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` works in chats where you have a Blend with the person too. Swiping up goes through the reels shared in the chat first, and the Blend's reels come after them. Asked for in #804.

- The `Blocked words` row under `Hide reels by caption words` now says how much your list has hidden, in the last 24 hours and in all, counting reels, Home posts and comments. Asked for in #807.

- `Instagram settings page` is new under `Settings entry`. HushGram's settings look like Instagram's own, with plain rows, gray section names and its round switch, in dark or light to match. It wins over the Black and Light looks. Asked for in #797.

- `Don't open reels from chats` is new under Messages. A reel someone shares in a chat stays closed when you tap it, and a short note says reels from chats are off. Photos, videos and shared posts still open. Asked for in #810.

- `Reels on Home below the name` is new under Feed. Reels on Home show like other posts, with the name and three-dot menu above the video instead of on it. Live videos and other reels keep Instagram's layout. Asked for in #788.

- `Time on the seek bar` is new under `Seek bar on stories`. It shows the time played and the story's length, like 0:03 / 0:15, and a tap (or `Show the time left`) counts down instead. Asked for in #784.

- `Copy text in the story menu` is new under Stories. Copy text in a story's three-dot menu copies the words Instagram read in the picture, or opens Google Lens when it found none. Starts off. Asked for in #789.

- `Full-size Reels icon` is new under Tab bar. Instagram's Reels icon is narrower than the others, so it looks small. This draws it a bit bigger to match, on top of your Tab icon size. Starts off. Asked for in #793.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

hushpinterest.title: v0.0.15
hushpinterest.body:
HushPinterest 0.0.15 has 59 patches for Pinterest 14.45.0, up from 36 in 0.0.14. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle. The signing key hasn't changed, and Manager should still show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`.

Most of this one came from your requests. You can hide pins you've already seen, pick your own font, splash logo and save sound, fold related pins away or drop them, and turn a lot more of Pinterest black in dark mode. Hide ads now also stops the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing when you open a pin. The feed filters leave the pins on your own boards alone, and email sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name.

Pinterest 14.44.0 isn't supported anymore. Get 14.45.0, patch it with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New `Hide pins you've already seen` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. Pins you scroll past or open on Home stay out of your home feed after that. `Hide seen pins for` picks how long they stay out: a day, a week, a month, or forever (the newest 50,000 pins). `Hide seen pins in search` does the same for search results, and `Forget pins you've seen` lets them all show again, with a second tap to undo it. Both switches start off. (#52)
- New `Custom font` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a .ttf or .otf file with Font file and Pinterest's text shows in it after a restart. Picking one turns the switch on, and the file is copied into Pinterest, so it keeps working if you move or delete the original. Icons keep their own look. It starts off. (#51)
- New `Save color on other red buttons` switch under Interface, part of Hide closeup buttons. Follow, Done and Pinterest's other red buttons take the color you picked for the Save button. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Black buttons` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's gray buttons, like Message and Edit profile on a profile, turn pure black and keep their labels. So do the gray chips over search results, like Filter, the rows of the "Refine your search" lists between results, and your account card at the top of Pinterest's own settings. It starts off. (#48)
- The patches now target Pinterest 14.45.0, version code 14458020. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer. Older Pinterest versions are refused.
- Long-pressing the Home button in the bottom bar now opens the HushPinterest settings, the same as long-pressing the Pinterest logo. The other buttons keep what Pinterest does with a long press. (#48)
- New `Hide the refresh pill` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. After you've been away, Home no longer shows the pill that offers new pins. Pull down on Home when you want them. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide Refine your search` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. The "Refine your search" lists of suggested searches leave your search results, and the pins close up where they were. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Swipe down to close pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pull a pin you opened down and it closes. Pinterest built this but only turns it on for some accounts. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Full-size profile photos` patch with its own switch under Interface. Tap someone's profile photo on their profile and it opens full size. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Best video quality` patch with its own switch under Interface. Videos play at the largest size Pinterest has instead of the size it caps them at. Pinterest already does this for some accounts. It uses more data and starts off. (#48)
- New `Board order when saving` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet lists your boards in the order your profile shows them instead of A to Z. Set your profile's boards to Custom order and drag them around, and the sheet follows. It starts off. (#48)
- With `Black bottom bar` on in dark mode, the strip at the very bottom is black from the moment Pinterest opens, instead of gray for a second until the bar shows. (#48)
- New `Pin video playback` patch with two switches under Interface. With `Don't autoplay pin videos` on, a video on a pin you open or swipe to waits for you to tap play, and a pin you go back to stays paused. With `Start pin videos muted` on, those videos start with the sound off, even after you turned the sound on for the one before. Both start off. (#48)
- New `Pinch to zoom only` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinching a pin's picture opens it full screen, where you can zoom in and drag it around, instead of loading pins that look like it. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Like and comment history` patch with its own switch under Privacy. It keeps a list on your phone of the pins you like and the comments and replies you post, and unliking a pin takes it off. Open it from Your likes and comments under Privacy, where you can filter it to likes or comments and tap an entry to open its pin. Clear empties it. The list keeps the newest 500 and never leaves the phone. The switch starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide suggested searches` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. On search results, the colored searches under the search bar stop showing and the row closes up behind them. The filter button stays. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide offline banner` switch under Interface, part of Hide pop-up banners. The bar at the top that says you're offline, then back online, stops showing. It starts off and takes effect the next time your connection drops. (#48)
- Pins you saved now stay on your own boards. Hide AI-labeled pins, Hide shopping and product pins, Hide video pins, muted words and the other feed filters leave alone any pin you own, saved yourself, or that sits on a board of yours or one you collaborate on, wherever it shows. They still filter other people's boards, and promoted pins still go everywhere. With Debug logging on, the log says which pin of yours stayed and why. (#49)
- New `Customize board tabs` patch with its switches under Interface, all off to start. On a board tab on Home, `Hide See board on board tabs` and `Hide More ideas for on board tabs` clear the picture at the top so only the board name is left, and `Board name position` moves the name to the top left, top center, middle, bottom center or bottom right. (#42)
- `Choose board tab covers`, also part of Customize board tabs, stops that picture changing. Turn it on and long-press the picture to keep the one showing, use a pin, pick a photo from your phone or go plain black. Each board remembers its own choice, and Pinterest's choice puts it back. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide download toasts` switch under Interface, part of Hide save toasts. Downloading a pin no longer shows the message that it started or finished. Errors still show, and Android's own download notification stays. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Black toasts` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's pop-up messages, like the one after you save or download a pin, turn pure black. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Second Search tap opens the keyboard` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. On the Search page, pressing Search in the bottom bar again puts the cursor in the search bar and opens the keyboard. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide Home tabs` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. It takes the row with All and your board names off the top of Home. It starts off. (#43)
- New `Hide pin menu rows` switch under Interface, part of Filter pin menu. Pick pin menu rows lists the rows of a pin's menu, the ones HushPinterest adds included, and the ones you pick stay out of the menus you open from then on. It starts off. (#43)
- New `Blank Search page` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. The Search page shows only the search bar, with nothing under it, and searching works as usual. It starts off. (#44)
- New `Hide pin title and description` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the title and description go away and the likes and comments bar stays, along with the posted date and image size if you have those on. It starts off. (#43, #44)
- New `Hide pin author` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the creator's whole row, picture and name included, out from under a pin you open. It starts off. (#44)
- New `Show image size` patch with its own switch under Interface. A picture's width and height show under it when you open a pin, next to the posted date if that's on. The numbers come from the largest copy Pinterest sends the app, so they can be smaller than the original upload. Videos show nothing. It starts off. (#43, #44)
- New `Hide blue highlight ring` patch with its own switch under Interface. It stops the thick blue ring Pinterest draws over buttons like Save when it wants to point out a feature. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide visual search thumbnails` patch with its own switch under Interface. The lens button on a pin's picture stays plain instead of showing a little stack of cropped pictures. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Fold related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. An arrow sits under a pin you open, and related pins don't load until you tap it. Tap again and they fold away. Your last choice carries over to other pins and restarts, and Hide related pins wins if both are on. It starts off. (#46)
- Download pin now looks for an idea pin's video on its pages and in their video blocks, where Pinterest keeps it, before saying the pin has no MP4. (#45)
- Hide ads now also takes sponsored boards out of the Explore featured boards row in Search. Boards Pinterest picks itself stay.
- Hide Home suggestions now also matches two row types from a Debug report of a Home showing "Inspired by your interests" and "More ideas for your board". (#30)
- Original-quality images now reaches the picture pages of idea pins. Each page picks its own picture from its own list, so the switch never got to them before. A picture too big for Android to draw stays at Pinterest's size. Pinterest sometimes lists an original under the wrong file type and its image server refuses it, which left a grey box. The app now tries the other types, then a large copy.
- Report a problem now opens your browser even when GitHub's app is installed. The app took the link, showed its own template list and lost everything the form had filled in.
- `Black menus and sheets` now also covers the drawer that slides up from the arrow under a pin, along with the fade above its buttons. (#21)
- Hide shopping and product pins now takes the Shop the look section out from under a pin you open, the title and its row of products both. Pinterest builds that section from the pin itself instead of a feed story, so the switch used to miss it. The pin's Visit button stays, and Export report lists the part as `Shop the look under pins`. (#6)
- New `Custom splash logo` patch with its own switch under Interface. On Android 13 and newer, the screen you see while Pinterest starts shows a logo you pick instead of Pinterest's. Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture in the patch's Logo option when you patch, or leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo. All of the picture shows, centered in a circle, so a square one with a clear background looks best. It starts off, and the logo shows from the next start after you turn it on. (#41)
- New `Custom save sound` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a sound file with Pick a save sound and it plays when you save a pin, instead of Pinterest's chime. Picking one turns the switch on, and the row can take you back to Pinterest's sound any time. If the file goes missing, Pinterest's chime plays. (#41)
- New `Hide related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. It leaves the grid of more pins out from under a pin you open, so Pinterest never loads it. The pin, its comments and its buttons stay. It starts off, and the change shows on the next pin you open. (#41)
- New `Hide creator name on pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the creator's name and badge go away while their picture stays, and tapping the picture still opens their profile. It starts off. (#41)
- New `Hide pop-up banners` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinterest sometimes slides a banner up over Home, like "Shop recommended merchants". With the switch on, HushPinterest closes it through the banner's own X as soon as Pinterest shows it, so Pinterest counts it as dismissed and that banner doesn't come back. A banner that's already open when you turn the switch on stays until you close it. The switch starts off, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, Pinterest shows its banners as before.
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer to apply them. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.
- New `Black Save to sheet` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode the sheet that lists your boards when you save a pin turns pure black, part way up and all the way up, along with the strip under it. The red Create new board button keeps its color. It starts off. (#31)
- New `Hide suggested boards` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards out of the Save to sheet. Your boards and Profile stay. It starts off. (#32)
- New `Expand board list` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet opens all the way up, so you see more of your boards without dragging it first. It starts off. (#33)
- Hide ads now goes after the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing in late October when you tap a pin. With the switch on, Pinterest hears that its full-screen ads are switched off. Turn Hide ads off or pause HushPinterest and Pinterest decides for itself again. Export report lists the part as `full-screen ads when opening a pin`.
- Spoof signature for Google sign-in now hands microG-RE Pinterest's own package name, `com.pinterest`, to send Google along with Pinterest's signature. Before, a copy made with Change package name went to Google under its new package name with Pinterest's signature, a pair Google doesn't know. It stays `com.pinterest` whatever the copy is called, and Export report has a new `spoof_package` line that says whether your build carries it. (#28)
- Email and password sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name. Pinterest's sign-in runs a reCAPTCHA check that only accepts the `com.pinterest` package, and the copy sent its own, so every email sign-in there ended in "Something went wrong". The copy now tells reCAPTCHA it's `com.pinterest`. (#28)
- With Debug logging and Hide Home suggestions both on, Export report now says what each page of your feed kept. A row of ideas shows its story type. Every other kind of item gets its field names listed once in a section of their own, which stays through Clear diagnostic data. It never includes a pin title or any other text. If a suggestion row still shows on your Home, a report like that says what the row is. (#30)
- Hide Home suggestions now also takes out the "More ideas for your board" row that sits over your own boards on Home's board tab. (#30)
- New `Hide Send with an app in the long-press menu` switch under Pin actions. It takes the button that sends a pin straight to WhatsApp, or whichever app you last shared with, out of a grid pin's long-press menu. Send still lists every app. It starts off. (#35)
- The red Save button under a pin you open no longer splits its label over two lines. That happened with a long translation, Romanian's for one, on a pin with lots of likes and comments. With Hide closeup buttons in your build, the label goes back on one line. The button's padding shrinks first, then the text gets a little smaller if it has to. The button is one line tall too, instead of keeping the height the two lines took. A pin with more room shows Pinterest's button as it was. (#38)
- New `Hide saved pins in search and More to explore` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. It takes pins you've saved or own out of search results and out of the More to explore pins under a pin you open. Your boards still show them. `Hide pins you've already saved` stays about your home feed. It starts off. (#34)
- New `Back leaves Home right away` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. Once you've scrolled down Home, Pinterest's Back jumps to the top and loads new pins, and only a second Back leaves. With the switch on, the first Back leaves Pinterest the way it does at the top of the feed. It works with Keep Home feed on or off, and it starts off. (#36)
- New `Long-press view` switch under Pin actions, part of Long-press download. It puts a View button after Download in a grid pin's long-press menu, the round one and the newer list. Slide onto it and let go, and the pin's full-size picture opens full screen right over the grid, without opening the pin. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, drag to look around, and Back or the X closes it. The picture isn't saved anywhere. View doesn't need Download pins on, and a video pin doesn't get it. It starts off. (#37)
- Two new switches under Interface, part of AMOLED black, both off to start. `Black menus and sheets` turns the other menus and sheets that slide up pure black in dark mode: Create, a board's Board view, sort and Options menus, Add collaborators and the rest. Their buttons and Create's tiles keep their gray. `Black board and profile buttons` does the same for the gray bar that floats over a board and the filter buttons on your profile, along with the empty cover on Edit board. A sheet with a switch of its own, like the Save to sheet or a pin's menu, still follows that one. (#39)
- In Morphe Manager's patch list, `AMOLED black` now sits in its own Theme group and `Open links in your browser` in a Links group, so the Interface group still fits on one screen with the two new patches in it.
- New `Let the screen sleep` switch under Interface. Pinterest keeps the screen on while a video is on it, playing or paused, so a pin left open with a video showing never let the phone sleep. With the switch on, the screen turns off after your phone's usual timeout. It starts off. (#47)
- `Show posted date` now shows just the date under a pin's title, without "Posted" in front, so the line takes less room. (#47)
- The last choice in a HushPinterest list dialog is no longer cut in half. A list of a few choices, like `Hide seen pins for`, `Board name position` or the download pickers, measured each row without its radio button or checkbox, so the dialog came out too short for the rows. (#52)
- The search box in HushPinterest settings now sits on every page, and it finds switches on all of them from wherever you are. Clear it or press Back and you're back on the page you were on, at the same spot.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.7.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.45.0, version code `14458020`. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer, so there's nothing to merge. Pick that file in Manager.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in. If you'd rather keep the stock app, pick Change package name in Expert mode and HushPinterest installs beside it with its own sign-in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.45.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). The bundle is signed for Morphe Manager with the key in [`morphe-signing.pub`](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub), and Manager should show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Reported issues

- #6: Hide shopping and product pins takes the Shop the look section out from under a pin you open.
- #21: `Black menus and sheets` covers the drawer that slides up from the arrow under a pin.
- #28: Email and password sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name.
- #30: Hide Home suggestions catches more of Home's suggestion rows, and Export report can name a row that still shows.
- #31: New `Black Save to sheet` switch.
- #32: New `Hide suggested boards` patch.
- #33: New `Expand board list` patch, so the Save to sheet opens all the way up.
- #34: New `Hide saved pins in search and More to explore` switch.
- #35: New `Hide Send with an app in the long-press menu` switch.
- #36: New `Back leaves Home right away` switch.
- #37: New `Long-press view` switch for a full-screen look at a pin straight from the grid.
- #38: The Save button's label stays on one line with long translations.
- #39: New `Black menus and sheets` and `Black board and profile buttons` switches.
- #41: Custom splash logo, Custom save sound, Hide related pins and Hide creator name on pins.
- #42: Customize board tabs with its own covers, plus Hide download toasts, Black toasts, the second Search tap, Hide blue highlight ring and Hide visual search thumbnails.
- #43: Hide Home tabs, Hide pin menu rows, Hide pin title and description, and Show image size.
- #44: Blank Search page and Hide pin author, along with the pin title and image size patches from #43.
- #45: Download pin finds the video on an idea pin's pages.
- #46: New `Fold related pins` patch.
- #47: New `Let the screen sleep` switch, and the posted date under a pin drops the word "Posted".
- #48: `Black buttons`, a black strip under the bottom bar from the start, and 13 more switches and patches asked for there, from Swipe down to close pins to Like and comment history.
- #49: The feed filters leave the pins on your own boards alone.
- #51: New `Custom font` patch.
- #52: New `Hide pins you've already seen` switch, and HushPinterest's list dialogs show their last choice whole.

repos.title: v0.0.15
repos.body:
HushPinterest 0.0.15 has 59 patches for Pinterest 14.45.0, up from 36 in 0.0.14. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle. The signing key hasn't changed, and Manager should still show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`.

Most of this one came from your requests. You can hide pins you've already seen, pick your own font, splash logo and save sound, fold related pins away or drop them, and turn a lot more of Pinterest black in dark mode. Hide ads now also stops the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing when you open a pin. The feed filters leave the pins on your own boards alone, and email sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name.

Pinterest 14.44.0 isn't supported anymore. Get 14.45.0, patch it with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New `Hide pins you've already seen` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. Pins you scroll past or open on Home stay out of your home feed after that. `Hide seen pins for` picks how long they stay out: a day, a week, a month, or forever (the newest 50,000 pins). `Hide seen pins in search` does the same for search results, and `Forget pins you've seen` lets them all show again, with a second tap to undo it. Both switches start off. (#52)
- New `Custom font` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a .ttf or .otf file with Font file and Pinterest's text shows in it after a restart. Picking one turns the switch on, and the file is copied into Pinterest, so it keeps working if you move or delete the original. Icons keep their own look. It starts off. (#51)
- New `Save color on other red buttons` switch under Interface, part of Hide closeup buttons. Follow, Done and Pinterest's other red buttons take the color you picked for the Save button. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Black buttons` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's gray buttons, like Message and Edit profile on a profile, turn pure black and keep their labels. So do the gray chips over search results, like Filter, the rows of the "Refine your search" lists between results, and your account card at the top of Pinterest's own settings. It starts off. (#48)
- The patches now target Pinterest 14.45.0, version code 14458020. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer. Older Pinterest versions are refused.
- Long-pressing the Home button in the bottom bar now opens the HushPinterest settings, the same as long-pressing the Pinterest logo. The other buttons keep what Pinterest does with a long press. (#48)
- New `Hide the refresh pill` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. After you've been away, Home no longer shows the pill that offers new pins. Pull down on Home when you want them. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide Refine your search` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. The "Refine your search" lists of suggested searches leave your search results, and the pins close up where they were. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Swipe down to close pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pull a pin you opened down and it closes. Pinterest built this but only turns it on for some accounts. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Full-size profile photos` patch with its own switch under Interface. Tap someone's profile photo on their profile and it opens full size. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Best video quality` patch with its own switch under Interface. Videos play at the largest size Pinterest has instead of the size it caps them at. Pinterest already does this for some accounts. It uses more data and starts off. (#48)
- New `Board order when saving` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet lists your boards in the order your profile shows them instead of A to Z. Set your profile's boards to Custom order and drag them around, and the sheet follows. It starts off. (#48)
- With `Black bottom bar` on in dark mode, the strip at the very bottom is black from the moment Pinterest opens, instead of gray for a second until the bar shows. (#48)
- New `Pin video playback` patch with two switches under Interface. With `Don't autoplay pin videos` on, a video on a pin you open or swipe to waits for you to tap play, and a pin you go back to stays paused. With `Start pin videos muted` on, those videos start with the sound off, even after you turned the sound on for the one before. Both start off. (#48)
- New `Pinch to zoom only` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinching a pin's picture opens it full screen, where you can zoom in and drag it around, instead of loading pins that look like it. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Like and comment history` patch with its own switch under Privacy. It keeps a list on your phone of the pins you like and the comments and replies you post, and unliking a pin takes it off. Open it from Your likes and comments under Privacy, where you can filter it to likes or comments and tap an entry to open its pin. Clear empties it. The list keeps the newest 500 and never leaves the phone. The switch starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide suggested searches` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. On search results, the colored searches under the search bar stop showing and the row closes up behind them. The filter button stays. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide offline banner` switch under Interface, part of Hide pop-up banners. The bar at the top that says you're offline, then back online, stops showing. It starts off and takes effect the next time your connection drops. (#48)
- Pins you saved now stay on your own boards. Hide AI-labeled pins, Hide shopping and product pins, Hide video pins, muted words and the other feed filters leave alone any pin you own, saved yourself, or that sits on a board of yours or one you collaborate on, wherever it shows. They still filter other people's boards, and promoted pins still go everywhere. With Debug logging on, the log says which pin of yours stayed and why. (#49)
- New `Customize board tabs` patch with its switches under Interface, all off to start. On a board tab on Home, `Hide See board on board tabs` and `Hide More ideas for on board tabs` clear the picture at the top so only the board name is left, and `Board name position` moves the name to the top left, top center, middle, bottom center or bottom right. (#42)
- `Choose board tab covers`, also part of Customize board tabs, stops that picture changing. Turn it on and long-press the picture to keep the one showing, use a pin, pick a photo from your phone or go plain black. Each board remembers its own choice, and Pinterest's choice puts it back. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide download toasts` switch under Interface, part of Hide save toasts. Downloading a pin no longer shows the message that it started or finished. Errors still show, and Android's own download notification stays. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Black toasts` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's pop-up messages, like the one after you save or download a pin, turn pure black. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Second Search tap opens the keyboard` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. On the Search page, pressing Search in the bottom bar again puts the cursor in the search bar and opens the keyboard. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide Home tabs` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. It takes the row with All and your board names off the top of Home. It starts off. (#43)
- New `Hide pin menu rows` switch under Interface, part of Filter pin menu. Pick pin menu rows lists the rows of a pin's menu, the ones HushPinterest adds included, and the ones you pick stay out of the menus you open from then on. It starts off. (#43)
- New `Blank Search page` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. The Search page shows only the search bar, with nothing under it, and searching works as usual. It starts off. (#44)
- New `Hide pin title and description` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the title and description go away and the likes and comments bar stays, along with the posted date and image size if you have those on. It starts off. (#43, #44)
- New `Hide pin author` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the creator's whole row, picture and name included, out from under a pin you open. It starts off. (#44)
- New `Show image size` patch with its own switch under Interface. A picture's width and height show under it when you open a pin, next to the posted date if that's on. The numbers come from the largest copy Pinterest sends the app, so they can be smaller than the original upload. Videos show nothing. It starts off. (#43, #44)
- New `Hide blue highlight ring` patch with its own switch under Interface. It stops the thick blue ring Pinterest draws over buttons like Save when it wants to point out a feature. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide visual search thumbnails` patch with its own switch under Interface. The lens button on a pin's picture stays plain instead of showing a little stack of cropped pictures. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Fold related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. An arrow sits under a pin you open, and related pins don't load until you tap it. Tap again and they fold away. Your last choice carries over to other pins and restarts, and Hide related pins wins if both are on. It starts off. (#46)
- Download pin now looks for an idea pin's video on its pages and in their video blocks, where Pinterest keeps it, before saying the pin has no MP4. (#45)
- Hide ads now also takes sponsored boards out of the Explore featured boards row in Search. Boards Pinterest picks itself stay.
- Hide Home suggestions now also matches two row types from a Debug report of a Home showing "Inspired by your interests" and "More ideas for your board". (#30)
- Original-quality images now reaches the picture pages of idea pins. Each page picks its own picture from its own list, so the switch never got to them before. A picture too big for Android to draw stays at Pinterest's size. Pinterest sometimes lists an original under the wrong file type and its image server refuses it, which left a grey box. The app now tries the other types, then a large copy.
- Report a problem now opens your browser even when GitHub's app is installed. The app took the link, showed its own template list and lost everything the form had filled in.
- `Black menus and sheets` now also covers the drawer that slides up from the arrow under a pin, along with the fade above its buttons. (#21)
- Hide shopping and product pins now takes the Shop the look section out from under a pin you open, the title and its row of products both. Pinterest builds that section from the pin itself instead of a feed story, so the switch used to miss it. The pin's Visit button stays, and Export report lists the part as `Shop the look under pins`. (#6)
- New `Custom splash logo` patch with its own switch under Interface. On Android 13 and newer, the screen you see while Pinterest starts shows a logo you pick instead of Pinterest's. Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture in the patch's Logo option when you patch, or leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo. All of the picture shows, centered in a circle, so a square one with a clear background looks best. It starts off, and the logo shows from the next start after you turn it on. (#41)
- New `Custom save sound` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a sound file with Pick a save sound and it plays when you save a pin, instead of Pinterest's chime. Picking one turns the switch on, and the row can take you back to Pinterest's sound any time. If the file goes missing, Pinterest's chime plays. (#41)
- New `Hide related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. It leaves the grid of more pins out from under a pin you open, so Pinterest never loads it. The pin, its comments and its buttons stay. It starts off, and the change shows on the next pin you open. (#41)
- New `Hide creator name on pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the creator's name and badge go away while their picture stays, and tapping the picture still opens their profile. It starts off. (#41)
- New `Hide pop-up banners` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinterest sometimes slides a banner up over Home, like "Shop recommended merchants". With the switch on, HushPinterest closes it through the banner's own X as soon as Pinterest shows it, so Pinterest counts it as dismissed and that banner doesn't come back. A banner that's already open when you turn the switch on stays until you close it. The switch starts off, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, Pinterest shows its banners as before.
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer to apply them. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.
- New `Black Save to sheet` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode the sheet that lists your boards when you save a pin turns pure black, part way up and all the way up, along with the strip under it. The red Create new board button keeps its color. It starts off. (#31)
- New `Hide suggested boards` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards out of the Save to sheet. Your boards and Profile stay. It starts off. (#32)
- New `Expand board list` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet opens all the way up, so you see more of your boards without dragging it first. It starts off. (#33)
- Hide ads now goes after the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing in late October when you tap a pin. With the switch on, Pinterest hears that its full-screen ads are switched off. Turn Hide ads off or pause HushPinterest and Pinterest decides for itself again. Export report lists the part as `full-screen ads when opening a pin`.
- Spoof signature for Google sign-in now hands microG-RE Pinterest's own package name, `com.pinterest`, to send Google along with Pinterest's signature. Before, a copy made with Change package name went to Google under its new package name with Pinterest's signature, a pair Google doesn't know. It stays `com.pinterest` whatever the copy is called, and Export report has a new `spoof_package` line that says whether your build carries it. (#28)
- Email and password sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name. Pinterest's sign-in runs a reCAPTCHA check that only accepts the `com.pinterest` package, and the copy sent its own, so every email sign-in there ended in "Something went wrong". The copy now tells reCAPTCHA it's `com.pinterest`. (#28)
- With Debug logging and Hide Home suggestions both on, Export report now says what each page of your feed kept. A row of ideas shows its story type. Every other kind of item gets its field names listed once in a section of their own, which stays through Clear diagnostic data. It never includes a pin title or any other text. If a suggestion row still shows on your Home, a report like that says what the row is. (#30)
- Hide Home suggestions now also takes out the "More ideas for your board" row that sits over your own boards on Home's board tab. (#30)
- New `Hide Send with an app in the long-press menu` switch under Pin actions. It takes the button that sends a pin straight to WhatsApp, or whichever app you last shared with, out of a grid pin's long-press menu. Send still lists every app. It starts off. (#35)
- The red Save button under a pin you open no longer splits its label over two lines. That happened with a long translation, Romanian's for one, on a pin with lots of likes and comments. With Hide closeup buttons in your build, the label goes back on one line. The button's padding shrinks first, then the text gets a little smaller if it has to. The button is one line tall too, instead of keeping the height the two lines took. A pin with more room shows Pinterest's button as it was. (#38)
- New `Hide saved pins in search and More to explore` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. It takes pins you've saved or own out of search results and out of the More to explore pins under a pin you open. Your boards still show them. `Hide pins you've already saved` stays about your home feed. It starts off. (#34)
- New `Back leaves Home right away` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. Once you've scrolled down Home, Pinterest's Back jumps to the top and loads new pins, and only a second Back leaves. With the switch on, the first Back leaves Pinterest the way it does at the top of the feed. It works with Keep Home feed on or off, and it starts off. (#36)
- New `Long-press view` switch under Pin actions, part of Long-press download. It puts a View button after Download in a grid pin's long-press menu, the round one and the newer list. Slide onto it and let go, and the pin's full-size picture opens full screen right over the grid, without opening the pin. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, drag to look around, and Back or the X closes it. The picture isn't saved anywhere. View doesn't need Download pins on, and a video pin doesn't get it. It starts off. (#37)
- Two new switches under Interface, part of AMOLED black, both off to start. `Black menus and sheets` turns the other menus and sheets that slide up pure black in dark mode: Create, a board's Board view, sort and Options menus, Add collaborators and the rest. Their buttons and Create's tiles keep their gray. `Black board and profile buttons` does the same for the gray bar that floats over a board and the filter buttons on your profile, along with the empty cover on Edit board. A sheet with a switch of its own, like the Save to sheet or a pin's menu, still follows that one. (#39)
- In Morphe Manager's patch list, `AMOLED black` now sits in its own Theme group and `Open links in your browser` in a Links group, so the Interface group still fits on one screen with the two new patches in it.
- New `Let the screen sleep` switch under Interface. Pinterest keeps the screen on while a video is on it, playing or paused, so a pin left open with a video showing never let the phone sleep. With the switch on, the screen turns off after your phone's usual timeout. It starts off. (#47)
- `Show posted date` now shows just the date under a pin's title, without "Posted" in front, so the line takes less room. (#47)
- The last choice in a HushPinterest list dialog is no longer cut in half. A list of a few choices, like `Hide seen pins for`, `Board name position` or the download pickers, measured each row without its radio button or checkbox, so the dialog came out too short for the rows. (#52)
- The search box in HushPinterest settings now sits on every page, and it finds switches on all of them from wherever you are. Clear it or press Back and you're back on the page you were on, at the same spot.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.7.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
